purpose: Bind the existing production systems into one governed consumption chain without creating a second runtime, authority, adapter, renderer, presentation system or web-production system.
handoffRules: Knowledge Runtime -> KAP uses governed read-only grounding
KAP -> Guided Reading occurs only when a simple answer needs limited clarification
KAP -> Reality Journey requires the decisive complexity gate and explicit consent
MR -> MPA preserves deterministic calculation and projection boundaries
MPA -> MCD is the only Method production-dispatch authority path
MCD -> Personal Runtime exposes canonical projections only
Guided Reading -> Reality Journey carries minimal context and provenance only
Reality Journey preserves Knowledge, Evidence and Calculation provenance
Client demand -> PJA/CAR is advisory candidate input behind human governance
CAR -> CPR projects approved or published assets only
Academy -> WPR is discovery-only while live learning delivery is inactive
Professional Runtime -> CPR carries attributable reviewed output only
CPR -> PDS maps presentation contracts to governed design tokens
PDS -> WPR supplies presentation constraints without runtime authority
WPR renders governed public/customer surfaces without upstream authority expansion
